To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
spermine, the major suppressive molecule of human semen, is an in vivo T suppressor, but only when it has undergone enzymatic oxidation.
spermine is the major suppressor of human T‐lymphocytes in vitro and that in vivo this effect is probably due to a spermine oxidizing enzyme.
the major suppressor of T‐lymphocytes in human semen is spermine and that the suppressive action requires the presence of a locally produced spermine oxidase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the nature of the T‐suppressive molecules in seminal fluid.

the characterization of the human seminal plasma factor which is capable of suppressing in vitro the proliferative response of lymphocytes to PHA and to alloantigens, as well as with the identification of the suppressor cells in human semen.
the study of human semen suppressive activity on lymphocyte proliferation in vitro.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the human seminal plasma contains a factor, which suppresses the T‐lymphocytes in vitro.
human spermatozoa contain a factor, probably spermine, which is capable of suppressing human T‐lymphocytes.
the human T‐suppressor is spermine and that the in vivo spermine oxidation is necessary for the T‐suppressive action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
spermine is the main suppressive factor of T‐lymphocytes in human semen.
the human seminal plasma contains two suppressive molecules: a T‐sup‐pressing molecule, spermine, and a B‐sup‐pressor, which is not yet defined.

spermine and spermidine in semen are responsible for the suppression of T‐cell activation, and that spermine oxidase, or an enzyme that converts spermine to spermidine, is necessary for this suppression to be exerted in vivo.
The main takeaway from our work is that
spermine is the main suppressor of T lymphocytes in vitro.
spermine is the major factor in semen that suppresses T‐lymphocytes in vitro.
the semen T‐suppressor is a spermine molecule that acts in the early phase of lymphocyte activation.
